ValidationRule.description: When the Extra_Work__c is checked, user must provide complementary information
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& Extra_Work__c = true
&& ( ISBLANK(Extra_Work_Comments__c)
|| ISBLANK( Extra_Work_Amount__c )
|| ISBLANK( Extra_Work_Start_Date__c )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : Extra Work Amount, Extra Work Comments, Extra Work Start Date
